title: LifeMod
description: LifeMod is the best moderation Minecraft plugin for every type of servers. LifeMod propose regulary updated for improve them.
body:
![Image for the features section](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c529d7685757b859bfcec77265285768d1afb4b.png)

Moderation mod for your moderators

and freeze, vanish and more in the plugin

![Image for the Commands section](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed582b78971d11afdec3973a91f275ae2f518821.png)

/mod -> to put you in moderation mode or remove you from moderation mode

/fly -> to put you in fly

/gm or /gamemode (0,1,2,3 or survival|creative|adventure|spectator) -> to put you in creative, survival, spectator or adventure

/broadcast alias /bc -> to send a message to all the server

/ecopen -> to open a person's ec

/vanish -> vanish you or other player

/clearinv -> clear inventory for a player or yourself

/stafflist -> Allows players to see moderators online

/staffchat -> Allows moderators and admins to chat together without players seeing messages

/heal -> heal yourself or a other player

/tp -> To tp on other person

/tphere -> to tp a person to you

/weather -> to change the time

/god -> to activate or deactivate god for invincibility

/freeze -> To freeze and unfreeze player

/invsee -> To see inventory of a player

/feed -> To feed you or other player

/speed -> To upgrade your speed on fly or walk.

/spectate -> To spectate an player

/lifemod [reload|info|serverinfo] -> To access of /lifemod info, /lifemod reload and /lifemod serverinfo

/oinvsee -> See the inventory of a offline player

/otp -> Teleport to an offlineplayer

/hearts -> set or add a specific amount of hearts to any player.

/settime -> Quickly set the world time to day, night, noon, or midnight.

/difficulty -> Change the server difficulty to peaceful, easy, normal, or hard

![Image for the permissions section](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/421e98b4dcc0b0b0be7cd2053ca2752325731dac.png)

/mod -> lifemod.mod

/fly -> lifemod.fly and lifemod.fly.others

/gm (/gamemode) -> lifemod.gm

/broadcast (/bc) -> lifemod.bc

/ecopen -> lifemod.ecopen

/vanish -> lifemod.vanish

/clearinv -> lifemod.clearinv

/stafflist -> nothing

/staffchat -> lifemod.staffchat

/heal -> lifemod.heal

/tp -> lifemod.tp

/tphere -> lifemod.tphere

/weather -> lifemod.weather

/god -> lifemod.god

/freeze -> lifemod.freeze

/invsee -> lifemod.invsee and lifemod.invsee.interact

/feed -> lifemod.feed

/speed -> lifemod.speed

/spectate -> lifemod.spectate

/lifemod -> lifemod.use

/oinvsee -> lifemod.oinvsee

/otp -> lifemod.otp

/hearts -> lifemod.hearts

/settime -> lifemod.time

/difficulty -> lifemod.difficulty

Bypass for blacklist words -> lifemod.chat.bypass
For seen blacklist words -> lifemod.chat.views

![Image for the help section](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c06fcfcbe7e67e728b6148c75eded3b952fa512b.png)
